name: 91381 · Stevenson Rnh, CA
findings: ZIP 91381 (Stevenson Rnh) has 66 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91381 (Stevenson Rnh) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
